capital.evidence_quote: Maputo is the constitutional capital, largest seaport, and administrative centre of Mozambique

currency.evidence_quote: The Mozambican Metical (MZN, MT) is the sovereign currency regulated by Banco de Moçambique

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia de Moçambique

timezone.evidence_quote: Mozambique observes Central Africa Time (UTC+2) across all provincial jurisdictions year-round

voltage.evidence_quote: Single-phase household distribution voltage across Mozambique is 220V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: EDM network maintains standard synchronized alternating frequency of 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: South African large three-pin round Type M and European Types C and F sockets are common

police.evidence_quote: Dial 119 nationwide for emergency response from Polícia da República de Moçambique (PRM)

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 117 nationwide for public hospital emergency medical ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 198 for SENSAP national firefighter brigade and structural rescue teams

general.evidence_quote: Emergency number 112 connects to unified emergency coordination services across mobile operators

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Tembihli Seyahat (Kıyı, Bazaruto ve Tofo Plajları Sakin; Cabo Delgado'dan Kaçının)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Increased Caution (Beaches & Bazaruto Archipelago Safe; Avoid Cabo Delgado)
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht (Küste, Bazaruto und Tofo sicher; Cabo Delgado im Norden meiden)
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность (Пляжи и архипелаг Базаруто спокойны; избегайте Кабу-Делгаду)
advisory_headline.es: Tenga mayor precaución (Playas y archipiélago de Bazaruto seguros; evite Cabo Delgado)

regional_warnings.reason: Violent extremist insurgency and armed attacks; all travel strictly discouraged

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Mozambique shows median mobile download speeds of 24.8 Mbps across Vodacom and Movitel 4G networks

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Mozambican fixed broadband delivers median download speed benchmarks around 18.5 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: SIM cards purchased at Maputo Airport or telecoms shops with passport registration; Vodacom M-Pesa is dominant mobile payment method
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Subscriber identity registration mandatory under national telecommunications authority regulations

religion.value: Christianity (~60% - Catholic and Zionist Christian), Islam (~19%), traditional animism (~14%)
religion.evidence_quote: National census details Christian majority alongside substantial Muslim communities along the northern coast

festivals.value: Marrabenta Festival (Maputo), Chopi Timbila Festival (Inhambane), Festival do Ibo, Independence Day (June 25)
festivals.evidence_quote: Chopi Timbila orchestral music inscribed by UNESCO, celebrated across vibrant coastal cultural festivals

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Portuguese is the official national language; avoid photographing military personnel, airports, or bridge checkpoints; strictly respect marine reserve guidelines (whale sharks, coral reefs); carry passport copies for police checkpoints
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Identification documents must be carried; photographing strategic government assets strictly forbidden

tipping.value: Customary in coastal resorts and tourist restaurants; 10% is customary for table service; small tips for luggage porters and diving crew
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is customary across coastal tourism centers and maritime excursion providers
